simplified_text:
If someone tries to avoid being served with a court document, such as a summons or notice, by running away, they will be punished. 

The punishment is simple imprisonment for up to one month, or a fine of up to fifty rupees, or both. 

This applies if the document is issued by a public servant who has the authority to do so. 

If the document requires the person to attend a court in person or through an agent, or to bring a document to court, the punishment is more severe. 

In this case, the person will be punished with simple imprisonment for up to six months, or a fine of up to one hundred rupees, or both.
